cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last years building AI systems that combine language understanding with real-world constraints. My PhD work on hybrid evaluation metrics for Turkish summarization required designing reward-like metrics and testing them on large text corpora, which gave me practical experience in shaping model behavior and measuring performance across modalities.

At Toros University I co-founded the SmartLab Technology Center and led projects that integrated NLP models with medical imaging data for diagnostic support. This involved setting up distributed training pipelines, curating multimodal datasets, and publishing the results at international workshops. My recent participation in the COST InsectAI and Net4Brain networks further sharpened my skills in collaborative, large-scale AI engineering.

I have a solid record of publishing peer-reviewed papers on trustworthy AI and multimodal NLP, and I regularly present findings at venues such as CISPA Trustworthy AI Summer School and ELSA Workshop. I enjoy turning experimental insights into reproducible code and robust evaluation protocols.

I would like to apply my background in multimodal research, system design, and rigorous experimentation to advance agentic reinforcement learning at your team.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
